releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.6.3 - UI Position & Version Display Polish
releaseNotes:
• Fixed UI Upper Position Alignment: Fixed outer Scaffold double-padding bug that was causing massive empty space above the dashboard header.
• Fixed Version Display in Settings: 'Check for Updates' now accurately displays the current installed version (v1.6.3) and indicates updates cleanly.
• Smooth Pinned Scroll Behavior: Top bar transitions cleanly when scrolling, preventing cards from bleeding through.
• KyawGyi CPU Optimization: Tuned Connection Tracking idle socket timeout and internal quota checkpoints, significantly lowering dual-core CPU strain under heavy loads.
